body:
Adds capture-scoped contribution observations, bounded immutable recording/metadata storage, authoritative enrollment/policy handling and authenticated upload/retry/receipt settlement. Reuses the recognition engine and actual executor outcomes; contribution work stays separate from recognition and playback actions. The service retains the sharing model/trigger and cleans up registrations when released.

This is the complete standalone upload range. Preserve its review/fix history. Auth/password and cloud-player/tail fixes from PR56–58 are not included; cloud/playback changes here report contribution outcomes.

Full-range review identified three source gaps, now corrected in reviewed commits ac6d64cab, ec139ec628 and bee470758:

- A capture-owned outcome deadline starts at segmentation completion and chooses one immutable record with normal completion. Late callbacks cannot rewrite it or repeat/cancel the user's action.
- Actual loaded-model references are captured at invocation boundaries; genuinely unknown components remain null. Invocation-specific Canary translation configuration is preserved.
- Daily capture admission takes a prepaid single-use reservation before contribution PCM copying. Account/window-bound durable accounting survives queue drain and restart without refunds. Explicit trusted first provisioning is separate from ordinary recovery; missing accounting cannot silently reset to zero. One off-path refill keeps storage work away from audio admission.

Draft and unready for activation. Product UI/upload trigger are compiled off; that constant is not collection authority. Remote policy plus authoritative enrollment/consent remains the gate, and actual remote/account activation state is unverified. No build-time collection authority is introduced. Production daily limits/ceilings, outcome wait/ceiling, established window and first-provisioning authority remain unavailable. No rollover or automatic reprovisioning is implemented.

Account enrollment/withdrawal/server-deletion uses the existing account navigation and a lifecycle-bound screen. Production enrollment requires an approved disclosure version; withdrawal and deletion remain independent, with deletion acknowledgement pending only. Upload admission supports validated noncellular/any-connected allowances, cancellation on path loss and actual request restrictions; production allowance remains unavailable. Authenticated plan/enrollment attributes request Analytics user-property publication with privacy/session fencing. Queue-root backup exclusion uses the platform property and uncached readback before retention/recovery/serving.

Validation is scoped, not a whole-feature or full-suite pass. The deadline slice passed 77 focused tests, provenance passed 111, and the final daily slice passed 126 (each zero failed/skipped, independently checked from XCResult; counts overlap and are not additive). Daily host controls exercise 16 actual child-process crashes, initializer/established-ledger contention, complete accounting-loss refusal and 23 named file/directory sync failures. Isolated charge, stale-authority, lifecycle, durability, reprovisioning, lock, intermediate-copy and admission omissions fail. Final 17 committed files match tested pins; Reviewer independently reran host controls and cleared draft publication of bee47075863158d8bf6f2b8b8918e3eda711dc91.

Earlier reviewed slices cover signout/account-deletion purge, service dependency lifetime, policy-disable cancellation, enrollment lookup/follow-up, configured loopback retry/receipt settlement, request restrictions, Analytics requests, account model/navigation and backup-property enforcement. An older complete-class attempt recorded 30 passed/1 cancelled in a full-model cold-start test; it is not a 49-test pass.

Power-loss persistence, network delivery, physical routing/background behavior, live server/Firebase acceptance, acoustic/model-loading behavior, hashing cost and whole-feature latency remain unverified. Rendered account views are not interactive tap acceptance; backup-property checks do not establish OS backup behavior or removal of existing copies. Backend dataset deletion/export/retention acceptance belongs to its owning lane. No full-PR readiness, paid review, installation, activation or merge is included.
title: Add Voice Sharing collection records and durable authenticated uploads
